Read input: origen_031131.v · Open raw
module origen_031131 #(
    parameter WIDTH = 8,
    parameter DEPTH = 4,
    parameter OFLOW = "REPLACE"
) (
    input wire reset,
    input wire clk,
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] wdata,
    input wire store,
    input wire read,
    output reg [WIDTH-1:0] rdata,
    output wire empty,
    output wire full,
    output reg overflow
);

    localparam NELEM = 2**DEPTH;

    reg [WIDTH-1:0] buffer [0:NELEM-1];
    reg [DEPTH-1:0] rpos, wpos;
    wire [DEPTH-1:0] wpos_next;
    wire dostore;

    assign empty = (rpos == wpos);
    assign full = (wpos_next == rpos);
    assign wpos_next = wpos + 1'b1;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            rpos <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
            wpos <= {DEPTH{1'b0}};
            overflow <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (read && !empty) begin
                rdata <= buffer[rpos];
                rpos <= rpos + 1'b1;
            end
            if (dostore) begin
                buffer[wpos] <= wdata;
                wpos <= wpos_next;
            end
            overflow <= (store && full);
        end
    end

    generate
        if (OFLOW == "REPLACE") begin : gen_replace
            assign dostore = store;
        end else if (OFLOW == "IGNORE") begin : gen_ignore
            assign dostore = store && !full;
        end else begin : gen_error
            OFLOW_value_not_valid error_here();
        end
    endgenerate

endmodule
